criteria: Five endpoints, ring connectivity, documented link/flit/latency settings
Exactly ten 64-byte packets per endpoint to its next neighbor; no substituted random workload
Fifty arrivals, intended destinations, and no duplicates verified by an executable oracle
Natural finite-workload termination and zero C++ changes
Command reproducible against the run installation
rule: Pass only when all criteria have execution evidence. Missing prerequisites or a source capability gap demonstrated under the task constraints is blocked, not pass. An unsupported substitution is fail. Evaluate behavior rather than an exact implementation.
